item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 18 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 18 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 02 September 2026(Wednesday)

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains are expected over Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas(Nasugbu, Tanauan, Talisay, Laurel), Laguna(Binan, San Pedro, Calamba, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa) and Quezon(General Nakar).

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac(San Jose, Capas, Bamban), Zambales(Botolan, San Felipe, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Castillejos, Subic), Bataan(Dinalupihan, Abucay, Hermosa, Orani, Samal), Pampanga(Floridablanca, Mabalacat, Arayat, Santa Ana, Mexico, Porac, Angeles, Guagua, Santa Rita, Bacolor, San Fernando, Lubao, Sasmuan, Candaba), Nueva Ecija(San Isidro, Cabiao, Gapan, Pantabangan, General Tinio), Bulacan(San Miguel) and Rizal(Antipolo, San Mateo, Cainta) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
